observations.what: The 'enriched_memory_source' variable controls whether the attempt_memory source dict includes a 'state' key. When True, dict has 'state' and 'tasks_remembered'; when False, only 'read' and 'tasks_remembered' are present, omitting 'state'. This inconsistency may confuse consumers.

In the 'else' branch of the attempt memory block (lines ~2558-2562), the source dict includes 'path' with str(db_path) even when db_path is None. This results in 'path': 'None' (string) rather than None. This is likely a bug.

The render_queue function constructs a human-readable string but does not handle the case where queue.sources values might not be JSON-serializable (though default=str is provided). No issues seen in this chunk.
review_packet function signature includes parameters diff_limit and gate_tail but the function body is not present in this chunk. Cannot verify usage.
